errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

age.title: How old are you?
age.body: PitchProof adjusts what is public and who can contact you based on your age group.
age.teenConfirm: I am between 13 and 17. I understand my parent or guardian has to approve my account before I can use PitchProof.
age.noBirthDate: We only store your age group, never your date of birth.
age.childNotice: Under 13 you can log matches and training, set goals, keep videos and get AI feedback if your parent allows it. Your account is private: nobody else can see your profile, find you or contact you. A parent or guardian has to give permission before you can start.
age.childConfirm: I am under 13. I understand a parent or guardian has to give permission before I can use PitchProof.

guardian.requestBody: We will email your parent or guardian a link. They choose what PitchProof may do with your account. Until then, your account stays private and limited.
guardian.declinedBody: Your parent or guardian did not approve the account. You can ask again if they change their mind.
guardian.revokedBody: Guardian consent was withdrawn, so youth features are paused. You can ask your parent or guardian again.
guardian.expiredBody: Guardian consent is renewed every year. Ask your parent or guardian to confirm again.
guardian.firstNameLabel: Your first name (shown in the email)
guardian.emailPrivacy: We only use this address for consent and safety emails about your account.
guardian.waitingTitle: Waiting for your parent or guardian
guardian.waitingBody: We emailed {{email}}. Once they approve, PitchProof unlocks automatically.
guardian.whatHappens: Your guardian decides separately about a public profile, being found by scouts, scout requests, shared videos and AI analysis. Any trial invitation also needs their approval.
guardian.resend: Send again or use another email
guardian.childRequestBody: Enter your parent's or guardian's email. We send them a notice that explains PitchProof and a form to sign. Your account stays locked until they confirm.
guardian.childWaitingBody: We emailed {{email}}. Ask your parent to read the email and sign the form.
guardian.childConfirmingBody: Your parent signed the form. They now have to click the confirmation link in a second email sent to {{email}}.
guardian.childWhatHappens: Your account is private. Nobody else can see it, find it or contact you. Your parent also decides whether AI analysis may be used.
guardian.childDeadline: Without permission this account and its data will be deleted on {{date}}.

settings.title: Age and guardian
settings.guardianApproved: Approved by your parent or guardian ({{email}})
settings.revokeHint: Youth features pause until your guardian approves again.
settings.changeAge: To correct your age group, contact PitchProof support.
settings.guardianDecides: Your parent or guardian decides this. Ask them to update their choices from their confirmation email.
settings.privateMode: Your account is private. Nobody else can see your profile, find you or contact you.
settings.revokeHintChild: Your account locks until your parent gives permission again. Without new permission it is deleted after 14 days.

trial.awaitingGuardian: Waiting for your parent or guardian to approve this trial.
trial.guardianDeclined: Your parent or guardian declined this trial.

privateMode.title: Private account
privateMode.body: Only you can see your profile, matches and videos. There is no public Passport, no search listing and no contact from scouts or other users.
